# KNI Education (Khánh Nhật Institute)

> KNI Education is the premier TestAS preparation academy in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Specializing in TestAS (Test for Academic Studies) exam training, German university admissions, and Vietnamese-German University (VGU) direct admission and scholarship preparation.

## Overview
- **Name**: KNI Education (Khánh Nhật Institute)
- **Website**: https://kni.vn
- **Core Mission**: Providing structured, high-efficiency TestAS preparation and academic orientation for Vietnamese students aspiring to study in Germany or enroll in VGU with scholarships.
- **Track Record**: 95%+ pass rate, 100+ students admitted to VGU and top German universities (TU9).
- **Format**: In-person classes in Ho Chi Minh City and interactive online classes via Zoom nationwide.

## Courses & Tuition Fees
- **Online Group Course (Học Online Nhóm)**: 4,500,000 VND / course. Live via Zoom, lecture recordings, official updated materials, free support until students reach their target score.
- **In-Person Group Course (Học Tại Trung Tâm TP.HCM)**: 6,500,000 VND / course. Physical classes in Ho Chi Minh City, face-to-face mentorship, practice test simulations.
- **1-on-1 Personalized Tutoring (Kèm 1-1 Cá Nhân Hóa)**: Customized roadmap tailored to individual target scores and timelines.
- **Full VGU Admission & Scholarship Package**: 8,500,000 VND. Comprehensive Core Test + elective Subject Module, timed mock tests, and scholarship application strategy.

## Key TestAS Information & Admissions Insights
- **What is TestAS**: Standardized cognitive test measuring academic reasoning (not rote learning) for non-EU students entering German universities.
- **Formats**: Paper-based (Paper TestAS, ~4.5h) and computer-based (Digital TestAS, 3.5h, 6 subject modules, one-way question navigation).
- **Validity**: Lifetime validity; certificates never expire. Grade 11 and 12 students can sit the exam early.
- **VGU Admission Formula**: Composite score = 40% Core Test + 60% Subject Module. Minimum threshold is 50/100 points per Digital TestAS section. High scores (115–125+) qualify for 25%–100% merit scholarships.
- **German University Admission**: Mandatory for Vietnamese high school graduates applying for APS verification and Uni-assist university applications.
